_instructions: Goal: Find 3-5 usable fields with predictive power outside submitted families
Method: Simple ts_rank test per field, None neutralization, decay 0
Skip if alphaId=null (field doesn't exist) - that's valid diagnostic info
Hypothesis types: behavior(reversal/momentum/volatility), expectation(earnings/sentiment), quality(value/profitability), event-gating
author: Claude
diagnostic_objective: Find fields with: (1) non-zero coverage >60%, (2) Sharpe > 0.3 as simple ts_rank, (3) not overlapping with submitted families
